game.title: Nioh
game.blurb: Samurai action RPG of yokai battles across a war-torn Japan, from Team NINJA, released 2017-02-07. RAWG has no playtime yet. Genres: Action, RPG. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: The main missions from the Kyushu region to the Omi region, and the second circuit around Japan.

chapters.title: The Tohoku Region
chapters.summary: Missions in the Tohoku region, Aoba Castle, and its Kodama and hot springs.

chapters.title: The Sieges of Osaka
chapters.summary: Missions of the Siege of Osaka (Winter and Summer), the Sanada and their Ten Braves, and their Kodama and hot springs.

chapters.title: Kodama, Hot Springs and Side Goals
chapters.summary: Kodama, hot springs, Guardian Spirits, gestures, yokai, side bosses and mission secrets in the main regions.

chapters.title: Levels, Weapons and Mystic Arts
chapters.summary: Levels, weapon proficiency, mystic arts for every weapon and magic, and weapon-only boss fights.

chapters.title: Forge, Gear and Looks
chapters.summary: Forging, the blacksmith, Muramasa, best materials, divine gear, appearance and disguises.

chapters.title: Twilight, Co-op, Way of the Strong and The Abyss
chapters.summary: Twilight missions, co-op with other players, harder Way of the Strong missions, The Abyss and the all-achievements goal.

notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has a stub page (completion stage 0); its Walkthrough, Gameplay, Controls and "Achievements and trophies" subpages are linked but not written, and the only written subpage is a 320-character Table of Contents, so nothing was used. nioh.fandom.com answers the API, but its "Nioh" page has only 2 linked pages ("Team Ninja" and "William"); names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam app is "Nioh: Complete Edition" (485510); its schema calls it "Nioh". None of the 79 Steam achievements is hidden. Achievements 47 to 79 name the Tohoku region and the Siege of Osaka (Winter and Summer), so they likely come from add-on content, but no add-on names appear in the data, so the chapters are named after those places. "The Sparrow Flies Again", "Resentment Unleashed" and "The Last Samurai" were put in the Osaka chapter because they sit among the Osaka and Sanada achievements in the schema, which is a guess. RAWG has no playtime for this game.
